$comment: Single source of truth for WASM memory sizing across every module Hyphon links.
Consumed by emscripten/build.sh (-s INITIAL_MEMORY / -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY),
emscripten/build_rubberband.sh, tools/build_jc303_omp.sh, and by
src/audio-worklets/hyphonNativeImports.ts, which allocates the imported
WebAssembly.Memory for the AudioWorklet instantiation path. The two MUST agree:
an imported memory whose `initial` is below the module's declared minimum fails
instantiation, and one far above it wastes address space (and can fail outright
on mobile Safari / low-end Chromebooks when `shared: true`).
See docs/wasm/BUILD_NOTES.md#four-worlds-memory-budget for the derivation.
Voices only, as of the Rubber Band split: Open303 / JC303 / Prophecy /
HighFid303 / audio_dsp. Rubber Band moved to its own module (see `rubberband`
below), which removed the ~40 MB stretch transient from this heap. 128 MB is
kept rather than tightened because the previous figure was an analytic budget,
not a device capture — lower it only with a measurement.
Standalone public/rubberband.wasm, built by emscripten/build_rubberband.sh and
instantiated by src/audio-worklets/{rubberband,sustain}-processor.ts through
createRubberBandModule(). This module owns its memory (it is NOT imported), so
the only contract is that build_rubberband.sh reads these numbers instead of
carrying literals. 64 MB covers the ~40 MB finer-engine stereo stretch peak
plus scratch; growth to 256 MB stays available for long offline renders.

assemblyScript.$comment: --initialMemory is in 64 KiB pages, not MB.

$comment: Effective link settings for the standalone JC-303 variants built by
tools/build_jc303_omp.sh + tools/jc303_cmake/CMakeLists.txt.
These match the CMakeLists values that actually shipped (16 MB initial,
2/4 MB stack). The old 64/32/256 banner in the shell script was never
passed through to the linker. Raise here — not in banners — if the
standalone fallback overflows.
